stem: What are Marvin's parents most likely thinking at this point in the story?
instruction:
Read this sentence.

_Marvin's parents looked at Marvin, first on TV, then on the stairs._

options.label: F
options.text: They hope that Marvin will become a leader someday.

options.label: G
options.text: They realize that Marvin had wanted to tell them something important.

options.label: H
options.text: They wish that Marvin had asked the president a better question.

options.label: J
options.text: They wonder why Marvin didn't tell them about meeting the president.

visual_elements: Marvin's parents looked at Marvin, first on TV, then on the stairs.
